beat_index.summary: Outside council chambers, guards stop the party and Thalia intervenes while Wolf's head is prepared for transport.
On the street en route to the academy, covert guards inspect for meat and tainted meat is burned.
At Stormspire Academy intake, Mossglade and Cinderbranch receive the party and discuss next steps.
Academy planning beat where options are set and the party splits between Torbin and necromancer tracks.
Ephanna and Baergrom check on Torbin with Tealeaf and remain with him.
Necromancer agrees to help and ritual prep proceeds while others take a short rest in the study room.
Group regroups in academy corridor, discovers escaped meat, and splits into ritual and hunt teams.
In the basement morgue, Stafl and Bonogo conduct Speak with Dead questioning of Wolf.
Post-ritual reveal as Draven locks the room and elite guards plus sewer monster emerge.
Combat exchange in the morgue between Stafl/Bonogo and Draven, elite guards, and sewer monster.
Retreat phase at the morgue doorway as Stafl calls for help and Bonogo disengages after a final strike.
Aftermath report to Cinderbranch, empty ritual room discovered, and mages assist pre-tunnel resupply.
